subject.title: fix(gateway): keep configured local auth authoritative

question: Should implicit clients for a configured local Gateway permanently use `gateway.auth.*` ahead of ambient Gateway credential variables, with environment-owned local auth expressed through an environment SecretRef?
rationale: This is a deliberate compatibility-policy change for existing local deployments, not a mechanical correctness choice; the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling despite the branch's consistent implementation and proof.

options.title: Accept configured-local authority
options.body: Adopt the branch contract so configured local clients and the Gateway server always share `gateway.auth.*`, with environment values serving only as absent-config fallbacks.

options.title: Preserve ambient overrides
options.body: Retain environment-first local behavior and solve split-brain authentication through diagnostics or a separately designed opt-in mode.

options.title: Request a migration adjustment
options.body: Keep the core contract but require a more explicit upgrade or doctor path before merge for operators who intentionally manage local credentials through environment variables.

recommendation.title: Accept configured-local authority
recommendation.body: Adopt the branch contract so configured local clients and the Gateway server always share `gateway.auth.*`, with environment values serving only as absent-config fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this contributor directly to the active Gateway-auth implementation and its cross-surface coverage, although final compatibility acceptance remains a maintainer decision.
